svg.title: SIP: a status line, six header lines, an empty line
svg.desc: The SIP response of frame 649 of wireshark_aaa.pcap, 32 bits per row: the status line, the version SIP/2.0, a space, the three-digit code 100, a space, the reason phrase Trying and CR LF; then six header lines in the order this server sends them, Call-ID first, then CSeq: 6 REGISTER, From, To, Via and Content-Length: 0, and the empty line that ends the head; SipMessage keeps the start line, the five mandatory headers, the CSeq split into its number and its method, a Content-Length of 0 and an empty body.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
